# E0370: a lens's arithmetic may overflow

Integer arithmetic in a lens may exceed int64 for some instance. Bound the
fields the lens reads so that every result fits.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int64
				b: int64
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			n: input.a + input.b
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: 0
			b: 0
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0370]: n in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:23:7
   |
23 |             n: input.a + input.b
   |                ^^^^^
   |
   = note: n in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 computes input.a + input.b, whose result may be [-18446744073709551616, 18446744073709551614], outside int64; bound the fields it reads so that the result fits
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule arith-overflow)
```
